basic_r2000.dxf.notes: HIDDEN layer off, FROZEN layer frozen (one entity each); arcs: one crosses 0deg, one wraps a0>a1; ellipse full + elliptical arc

polylines_r2000.dxf.notes: 4 LWPOLYLINE (open, closed, bulges 1/-0.5/0.3, const width 0.4) + 1 heavy 2D POLYLINE (lineweight 80)

splines_r2000.dxf.notes: SPLINEs: control-point degree 3, rational with weights, fit-point, closed (fit points)

text_r2000.dxf.notes: TEXT x3 (rotated+width factor 0.8, centred, %%c %%d %%p codes), MTEXT with \P, bold font run, \U+00B0, \H2x; ; STYLE NOTES

blocks_r2000.dxf.notes: 5 INSERTs: 3 BOX (scale1, scale2/rot30, mirrored xscale -1), 1 nested ROOM(BOX), 1 array 3 cols x 2 rows; unreferenced block *U1

hatch_r2000.dxf.notes: 3 HATCH: solid polyline boundary; ANSI31 with edge-path incl. arc; solid with island (outer+inner loop)

dims_r2000.dxf.notes: 5 DIMENSIONs rendered to anonymous blocks (*D..) + LEADER

colors_r2000.dxf.notes: ACI 1,7,30,140,250, BYLAYER(256), truecolor, lineweights 25/50/-1, 4 linetypes, entity ltscale 0.5, global LTSCALE 0.5, BYBLOCK entities in block BYB

r12_ac1009.dxf.notes: R12: ASCII only, POLYLINE instead of LWPOLYLINE

r2007_ac1021.dxf.notes: non-ASCII text: e-acute, u-umlaut, Arabic alef

r2018_ac1032.dxf.notes: non-ASCII text: e-acute, u-umlaut, Arabic alef

extrusion_r2000.dxf.notes: CIRCLE/ARC/LWPOLYLINE with extrusion (0,0,-1) => mirrored OCS (x flips); LINE at z=5 for 3D flattening

unsupported_r2000.dxf.notes: Skippable: 3DFACE, XLINE, RAY, polyface/polymesh POLYLINE; 2 LINEs must still load. MESH and IMAGEDEF omitted.

binary_sentinel.dxf.notes: 22-byte binary DXF sentinel + random bytes; importer must reject as BINARY_DXF
